notes: The header strip is a single line holding only the two column labels - there is no separate caption line, so caption is empty. Units: bar size (side x side) in mm, theoretical weight in kg/m. Two columns only; both are centred and the header labels sit centred above them (label centres x=232/753, body text centres x=234/756). All 30 value cells are filled; all values are printed with a dot and two decimals (trailing zeros kept as printed, e.g. 12.60, 95.00, 113.00). No merged cells, no footnotes. The standard / steel grade (EN 10059, S235JR) is not printed in these two images. Reading method: every band read visually twice (2x bands and 4x label+value composites) and additionally decoded by glyph template matching on the binarised image (exact match for every glyph at three thresholds); all readings agree on all cells.
